decisions.reason: GA4 is the current analytics standard and central to the firm's analytics offering, so the firm keeps the plugin.
Universal Analytics is permanently discontinued by Google, so its poor results cannot be attributed to temporary causes, leading the firm to drop it despite sunk costs.
The retail system interface plugin supports the firm's integration services and any weak results are likely temporary, so the firm keeps it.
The shop relaunch SEO support service has high visibility with its own page and is central to the firm's announced direction, so the firm keeps it.
